effective_scope: W0 governance policy for the Kubernetes Go-to-Rust port
fail_closed_conditions: Reject an upstream source acquisition whose repository, annotated tag object, peeled commit, or Apache-2.0 license does not match specs/k8s-port/upstream-pin.json.
Reject a rust-skills-derived rule without seed_source, seed_license, and seed_commit.
Reject a bootstrap extractor or any of its dependencies until source, version, digest, license, SBOM, signature, provenance verification, and sandbox policy are recorded and accepted.

Reject every external artifact, including Ginkgo and conformance-test artifacts, until its source, version, digest, license, SBOM, signature, provenance verification, sandbox policy, and owner are recorded and accepted.
Reject generated or ported files lacking the required provenance record.
Reject release or activation when the required NOTICE emission has not been produced from the admitted provenance records.
Reject product code carrying a forbidden license.

notice.emission_rule: Emit from admitted per-file provenance records before release or activation; the output must attribute Kubernetes source and any admitted rule seeds or external artifacts that require notice.

per_file_provenance.validation_rule: Each ported or generated file must trace to the pinned upstream source and its generating receipt; a file influenced by a seed-derived rule must additionally carry all seed fields.

rust_skills_seed.rule: Only MIT-licensed rust-skills material with complete seed provenance may seed rendering-layer rules; a seed may not alter upstream correspondence.

bootstrap_extractor_dependencies.execution_rule: The Go extractor runs out of band as an artifact producer and is never invoked by verify(); its canonical SourceModel output is the governed engine input.
bootstrap_extractor_dependencies.two_pass_requirement: Two extractions for the same upstream pin must produce byte-identical SourceModel snapshots or the pin is rejected.

upstream_kubernetes.rule: Only the immutable source archive and commit identified by the upstream pin may supply Kubernetes-derived port material.

evidence_state.statement: This policy does not claim that an SBOM, signature, provenance attestation, bootstrap extractor artifact, or NOTICE output already exists.
evidence_state.w0_requirement: The policy is live now; the listed evidence is required before the corresponding artifact is admitted or activated.

external_artifacts.admission_rule: Every external artifact class is rejected until all required fields are independently verified; omission is not an advisory state.
